system.description:
A compact hunting bow, quicker to draw than a longbow but shorter of range and power.

Negative Traits: Fragile

Concealability: Long cloak

Damage: One lethal health level

Availability: Resources x2, Uncommon

Ammunition: Arrows (dozen) - Resources x2, Uncommon

Rate: One shot per action

Special Ability: Armor-Piercing, Staking (if wooden-tipped), Two-Hand Requirement

Uses the Archery Ability for combat retests.
system.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages), Rules, Systems and Drama
